description: This file defines the static class SugarHtml that provides helper methods for creating, parsing, and manipulating HTML and Smarty template elements within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for generating HTML tags, parsing HTML and Smarty strings into array structures, and rendering HTML attributes.

classes.name: SugarHtml
classes.description: A static class offering utilities for generating, parsing, and handling HTML and Smarty template code.

methods.name: createOpenTag
methods.description: Creates an opening HTML tag with attributes, optionally self-closing.

methods.name: createHtml
methods.description: Constructs an HTML block from a nested array structure, supporting cascade, sibling, and Smarty formats.

methods.name: parseSugarHtml
methods.description: Consets a SugarHtml array structure for common input elements, optionally including a Smarty template.

methods.name: parseHtmlTag
methods.description: Disassembles an HTML string into a nested array structure representing DOM elements.

methods.name: parseSmartyTag
methods.description: Disassembles a Smarty template string into a structured array, identifying template parts and embedded HTML/attributes.

methods.name: extractAttributes
methods.description: Parses a string of HTML attributes into a key-value array, handling quotes, Smarty tags, and nested structures.

methods.name: createAttributes
methods.description: Generates HTML attribute string from a key-value array of attributes.
